newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom hits record high of 5,000 esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom hits record high of 5,000 esc.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom hit an all-time high of 5,000 escudos on the Lisbon bourse on Friday, dealers said.
They said 163,659 shares of PT traded, up 52 escudos to 5,000 escudos at 1016 GMT.
PT later rose to a new record high of 5,028 escudos and dealers said it could test further highs today in euphoric market conditions.

"There had been some resistance to break through 5,000 escudos, but as soon as this happened new highs were tested, which shows that the rise is consistent," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
"The market is euphoric and is pushing up all the shares," another said. "PT is a big climber because it is among the stocks that have the best potential to rise."
Dealers said the Lisbon market was awaiting U.S. December jobs data later today and their impact on financial markets. If markets fell, there could be some impact on the PT share price, they said.
